Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Authorized administrator account in Nurses BD, keyed by lowercase verified Google email.

email.description: Lowercase Google account email address matching the document ID.

assignedDivision.description: Assigned Bangladesh division or All Bangladesh.

addedBy.description: Email or system identifier of the creator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on updates.

Nurse.title: Nurse
Nurse.description: Registered Bangladesh nurse directory profile and approval workflow record.

submittedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the submitting user or seeding admin.

bnmcNumber.description: Bangladesh Nursing & Midwifery Council registration number (4 to 30 characters).

upazila.description: Bangladesh upazila or thana name (0 to 50 characters).

hospitalName.description: Hospital, clinic, or health facility name (3 to 120 characters).

phone.description: Bangladeshi contact phone number (11 to 20 characters).

availabilityStatus.description: Current shift or emergency availability status.

bio.description: Short clinical summary or shift notes (0 to 400 characters).

approvalStatus.description: Admin moderation status; new non-admin registrations always start as PENDING.

reviewedBy.description: Email of the reviewing administrator (optional until reviewed).

reviewedAt.description: Server timestamp of admin review via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() (optional until reviewed).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on submission.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on modification.

/admins/{adminEmail}.description: Role-based access registry of administrators keyed by verified lowercase Google email.

/nurses/{nurseId}.description: Registered nurses directory across Bangladesh with approval workflow.
